text: [image: A graphic supporting Rep. Enrique Sanchez endorsing Amy Santiago for Rhode Island District 7 Representative, featuring a photo of Enrique Sanchez speaking into a microphone.]

[image: A political campaign poster featuring Rep. David Morales endorsing Amy Santiago for Rhode Island District 7 Representative. The poster has a textured dark blue background with torn red and white paper edges at the top and bottom. It includes a photo of a man in a blue suit, glasses, and a tie, surrounded by gold star graphics.]

[image: Invitation poster for a fundraiser event titled 'Cocktails and Bites FUDDRISSER' benefiting Amy Santiago for Rhode Island district 7 state representative. The event is scheduled for Monday, April 13th from 5:00 to 8:00 pm at Patriarca Restaurant & Tortillería, 1294 Chalkstone Ave, Providence, RI 02908. The poster features illustrations of drinks and tacos, a QR code for donations, and a photograph of four women, including Amy Santiago.]
[image: Poster announcing City Councilor Miguel Sanchez endorsing Amy Santiago for Rhode Island District 7 Representative, featuring a photograph of Miguel Sanchez in a red blazer.]
